title: ACEF Authorized Test Scope
description: Payload schema for authorized_test_scope records. Declares the authorized boundary for outside-customer testing of a target AI system: which surfaces may be probed, which identities may be used, side-effect policy, sandbox boundary, ownership proof, effective window, and authorizing actor. Cross-vendor concept: any agent-reliability product testing a third-party AI system must declare authorized scope per brief freddy-on-acef-requirements-v0.1.md §3.1.

scope_id.description: URN identifier for this authorized test scope.

scope_version.description: Semver-shaped version of this scope. Required to be present even on initial issue.

subject_ref.description: URN reference to the ai_system or ai_model being tested.

authorized_surfaces.description: Surfaces that the test harness is authorized to interact with.

surface_identifier.description: Stable identifier for the surface (URL, package coordinate, etc.).

authorized_identities.description: Identities the test harness is authorized to operate as.

side_effect_policy.description: Policy governing test-side-effects on the target system.

sandbox_boundary.description: How the sandbox boundary is enforced and verified.

ownership_proof.description: Evidence that the authorizing party owns or controls the subject system.

effective_from.description: Earliest moment the scope is in force.

effective_until.description: Latest moment the scope is in force. Null means open-ended. Validator MUST enforce effective_until > effective_from when non-null; this ordering rule is enforced at the validator level (cross-field), not in the schema.

authorizing_actor_ref.description: URN reference to the actor (customer representative) that authorized this scope.

kill_switch_ref.description: URN reference to the kill-switch endpoint or actor authorized to halt testing. REQUIRED when any authorized_surface has authorization_level 'production_capable_owner_authorized' (enforced via allOf below).

allOf.description: Rule from brief §3.1 validation rules: production_capable_owner_authorized authorization may only be granted with ownership_proof.proof_method drawn from the three methods that prove system ownership (dns_txt, well_known_file, sso_assertion). OAuth and HTTP header prove control of an account but not ownership of the underlying system. Additionally, kill_switch_ref becomes required when any surface carries this authorization level.
